children: Millrose Properties entered into a Commitment and Acceptance to exercise the accordion under its existing Credit Agreement. The move adds Flagstar Bank as a new lender and increases the revolving credit facility commitments by $50 million to $1.385 billion, with JPMorgan Chase Bank serving as administrative agent. The amendment is intended to bolster liquidity and broaden the lending syndicate to support ongoing corporate needs.
: Commitment and Acceptance increasing revolving credit facility commitments (accordion)
: Flagstar Bank and JPMorgan Chase Bank (Administrative Agent)
: Enhance liquidity and diversify lender base
